insights: The frontend-proxy service has a single pod (frontend-proxy-55b6b6c7d9-xqxz5) and its pod status is Running (healthy).
Envoy logs show normal startup and initialization: admin server started (0.0.0.0:10000), clusters initialized, RTDS finished, and workers started. No crash or repeated restarts observed.

Further investigation should focus on upstream service health and endpoints (Kubernetes Endpoints), service-to-service network connectivity, and DNS/resolution for the upstream targets.
